risks.note: Revenue and receivables are earned in foreign currencies while most expenses are in Indian rupees, so INR/USD movements affect revenue, margins and profitability, including through translation.
The business extends credit to international customers, which carries an inherent risk of delayed payments and defaults. A credit policy addresses this.
Regulatory rulings could force the company to withdraw products from certain geographies or redesign them, delaying releases and removing functionality customers rely on.
The company states that the entry of large players will bring fierce competition and raise the bar for eligibility, which will affect its business.

Delivery depends on attracting and retaining skilled employees in a very competitive market with rising IT-industry attrition. Weak succession planning or knowledge transfer could hinder strategy and execution.
New ways of consuming IT services could compress demand for, or put pricing pressure on, the existing delivery model.
Any damage to TechNVision's reputation for timely, quality delivery could reduce its market share.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Revenue and receivables are earned in foreign currencies while most expenses are in Indian rupees, so INR/USD movements affect revenue, margins and profitability, including through translation.
- The business extends credit to international customers, which carries an inherent risk of delayed payments and defaults. A credit policy addresses this.
- Regulatory rulings could force the company to withdraw products from certain geographies or redesign them, delaying releases and removing functionality customers rely on.
- The company states that the entry of large players will bring fierce competition and raise the bar for eligibility, which will affect its business.
- Delivery depends on attracting and retaining skilled employees in a very competitive market with rising IT-industry attrition. Weak succession planning or knowledge transfer could hinder strategy and execution.
- New ways of consuming IT services could compress demand for, or put pricing pressure on, the existing delivery model.
- Any damage to TechNVision's reputation for timely, quality delivery could reduce its market share.
